description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to agent tools, tool sections, policies, and agent configuration management within a larger project. It includes utility functions for resolving tool sections, profiles, policies, and agent attributes.

methods.name: resolveToolSections
methods.description: Resolves tool sections from a catalog result or returns fallback sections.

methods.name: resolveToolProfileOptions
methods.description: Returns available tool profile options based on catalog result or default options.

methods.name: normalizeAgentLabel
methods.description: Normalizes agent label by trimming name or identity name.

methods.name: resolveAgentAvatarUrl
methods.description: Resolves the avatar URL for an agent, prioritizing certain candidate URLs.

methods.name: agentLogoUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the agent's favicon based on a base path.

methods.name: resolveAgentEmoji
methods.description: Determines a likely emoji for an agent based on various candidate fields.

methods.name: agentBadgeText
methods.description: Returns 'default' if the agent ID matches the default ID, otherwise null.

methods.name: agentAvatarHue
methods.description: Generates a hue value (0-359) for an agent ID for consistent avatar coloring.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string.

methods.name: resolveAgentConfig
methods.description: Resolves agent configuration from a global config object.

methods.name: buildAgentContext
methods.description: Builds context information for an agent, including workspace, model, and skills.

methods.name: resolveModelLabel
methods.description: Resolves a display label for a model object or string.

methods.name: normalizeModelValue
methods.description: Removes the fallback count suffix from a model label.

methods.name: resolveModelPrimary
methods.description: Extracts the primary model identifier from a model object.

methods.name: resolveModelFallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves fallback models from a model object.

methods.name: resolveEffectiveModelFallbacks
methods.description: Returns fallback models from entry or default models.

methods.name: sortLocaleStrings
methods.description: Sorts strings in locale order.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredCronModelSuggestions
methods.description: Suggests models for cron configuration based on a config form.

methods.name: parseFallbackList
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated list of fallback models.

methods.name: resolveConfiguredModels
methods.description: Resolves configured models from the config form.

methods.name: buildModelOptions
methods.description: Builds a list of model options from config and catalog.

methods.name: compilePattern
methods.description: Compiles a string pattern into a pattern object for matching.

methods.name: compilePatterns
methods.description: Compiles an array of patterns into pattern objects.

methods.name: matchesAny
methods.description: Checks if a name matches any pattern in a list.

methods.name: isAllowedByPolicy
methods.description: Determines if a tool name is allowed based on a policy.

methods.name: matchesList
methods.description: Checks if a tool name matches any in a list.

methods.name: resolveToolProfile
methods.description: Resolves a tool profile policy.
